mapper.select: INSERT INTO runrun_v2.evidence_holds ( order_id, certification_id, reason, owner_id, review_due_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{certificationId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ownerId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{reviewDueAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE} ) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO runrun_v2.admin_audit_logs ( administrator_id, action, target_type, target_id, request_id, reason, metadata ) VALUES ( #{administratorId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, 'EVIDENCE_HOLD_CREATED', 'EVIDENCE_HOLD', #{holdId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{requestId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, jsonb_build_object('orderId', #{orderIdParameter,jdbcType=BIGINT}, 'certificationId', #{certificationIdParameter,jdbcType=BIGINT}) )
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, certification_id, released_at FROM runrun_v2.evidence_holds WHERE id = #{holdId,jdbcType=BIGINT} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO runrun_v2.admin_audit_logs ( administrator_id, action, target_type, target_id, request_id, reason, metadata ) VALUES ( #{administratorId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, 'EVIDENCE_HOLD_RELEASED', 'EVIDENCE_HOLD', #{targetId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{requestId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '{}'::jsonb )
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM runrun_v2.evidence_holds WHERE certification_id = #{certificationId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND released_at IS NULL
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO runrun_v2.evidence_deletion_audits ( certification_id, resource_type, resource_id, resource_storage_key, delete_after, policy_snapshot, status ) SELECT #{certificationId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, 'STUDENT_CARD', #{resourceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{storageKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deleteAfter,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, jsonb_build_object ( 'retentionDays', 30 ), 'REQUESTED' WHERE NOT EXISTS (
SELECT 1 FROM runrun_v2.evidence_deletion_audits WHERE certification_id = #{existingCertificationId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND resource_id = #{existingResourceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND status IN ('REQUESTED', 'DELETING', 'SUCCEEDED') )
mapper.select: SELECT id, certification_id, resource_id, resource_storage_key FROM runrun_v2.evidence_deletion_audits WHERE status IN ('REQUESTED', 'FAILED') AND delete_after <= now() ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT c.id, c.approved_photo_resource_id, c.approved_photo_storage_key, c.approved_photo_at FROM runrun_v2.courier_certifications c WHERE c.approved_photo_resource_id IS NOT NULL AND c.approved_photo_at <= now() - interval '30 days' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM runrun_v2.evidence_deletion_audits d WHERE d.certification_id = c.id AND d.resource_id = c.approved_photo_resource_id AND d.status IN ('REQUESTED', 'DELETING', 'SUCCEEDED'))
SELECT count(*) FROM runrun_v2.evidence_holds WHERE certification_id = #{certificationId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND released_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE runrun_v2.evidence_deletion_audits SET status = 'DELETING', attempt_no = attempt_no + 1 WHERE id = #{deletionAuditId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
UPDATE runrun_v2.evidence_deletion_audits SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', finished_at = now(), resource_storage_key = NULL WHERE id = #{deletionAuditId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
UPDATE runrun_v2.evidence_deletion_audits SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, finished_at = now() WHERE id = #{deletionAuditId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM runrun_v2.v2_orders WHERE id = #{orderId,jdbcType=BIGINT} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM runrun_v2.courier_certifications WHERE id = #{certificationId,jdbcType=BIGINT} FOR UPDATE
